name: 埃尔温·薛定谔
bio_short: 奥地利理论物理学家，波动力学的创始人。他提出了著名的“薛定谔方程”（`schrodinger_equation_1926`），描述了量子系统的波函数演化，并因此获得了1933年的诺贝尔物理学奖。他还提出了著名的“薛定谔的猫”思想实验。
bio_short_en: An Austrian theoretical physicist and the father of wave mechanics. He formulated the famous 'Schrödinger equation' (`schrodinger_equation_1926`) which describes how the quantum state of a physical system changes with time, winning the 1933 Nobel Prize. He is also famous for the 'Schrödinger's cat' thought experiment.
